issue: swópniyoysu is LOC.PL 'in dreams' where the English has 'a dream'; wéwket shows the delabialized *wekʷ- reduplicated aorist (Greek eîpe keeps the labial)
ǵn̥h₁yetōd (future imperative) where Byrd's text has ǵn̥h₁yetu; still a 3SG imperative
somHós is 'same, one'; the English 'alone' is a stretched sense
ḱl̥nwéntu is IMP.3PL ('let them listen') but the addressee is one person, 'listen and learn' (2SG; h₁ukdʰí is 2SG); should be 2SG imperative e.g. ḱludʰí
h₂ŕ̥tḱos h₁ím h₁épomes: verb is SBJV.1PL 'shall we seize' but the subject is the bear (NOM.SG) and the English is 'Will the bear seize it?'; needs 3SG h₁épeti
h₁n̥gʷléy is DAT/LOC.SG of 'ember' but it is the subject of h₁sénti 'are there embers'; needs NOM.PL h₁óngʷoles (as in the reply)
wédʰe here is the 'bind' homograph (pie-lex-wedheti-2); ok
ḱwṓ ḱóm: ḱóm 'with' takes the instrumental (ḱunéh₁) but ḱwṓ is NOM.SG; 'I am coming with the dog'
